description: MVP TEST della Torre degli Inferi. Solo frontend. Nessun backend runtime, nessun DB write, nessuna economy mutation. Progresso locale via AsyncStorage. 20 floors. Boss ogni 5 floors. First-clear marker locale (simulato). TEST placeholder visibile su tutta la schermata.

floors.unlock_chain: floor N unlocked when floor N-1 cleared (floor 1 always unlocked)

reward_model.first_clear_reward: DESIGN_ONLY_DISPLAY (no economy mutation; nessun wallet update)

combat_integration: NONE_RUNTIME (simulazione TEST; bottone Start → modal TEST con esito simulato; nessun call al backend combat engine)
